kaizen_proposals.title: Sharing of josh magazine on digital platforms
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Magazine is available in hardcopy
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Make magazine in digital form and make printed copy limited to be available for visitors and readers in waiting area

kaizen_proposals.title: Resale of damaged and rusted container.
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: The damaged and rusted container thrown as scrap.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Resale of damaged and rusted container to the manufacturer.

kaizen_proposals.title: Safe and efficient drum unloading
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Earlier two person required to take out material from drum which was time consuming, man Power consuming way.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Now drums are placed horizontally at an angle so that material can be take out easily without any etra power. There is a open close value attached with the drum that helps in taking out the sample without any spillage.

kaizen_proposals.title: Segregation of all packing bottles/can and lida
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Earlier we are facing issue in finding the correct size can /bottles. Finding caps/lids of these bottles was a time consuming process due to fwo manufacturer CNC and ACP.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Seperate Cage was made for segregation so that everything can be find and selected easily.

kaizen_proposals.title: Cover for waste Sink
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: In our lab earlier there were open sinks in which we wash out lab apparatus with solvents. The open sink system was not efficient in minimizing the solvent evaporation. The evaporated solvent was contributing in bad lab smell and VOC
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: We designed a lid on the top of the sink that can be taken off when used and can be put on when not in used

kaizen_proposals.title: POLICY FORMATION FOR LEARNING THROUGH ONLINE PORTALS LIKE SWAYAM
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: DO NOT HAVE ANY POLICY FOR ONLINE LEARNING PLATFORMS
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: TO ENCOURAGE OUR EMPLOYEES FOR SKILL DEVELOPMENT THROUGH ONLINE PORTALS LIKE SWAYAM .ON SUCCESFUL COMPLETION OF COURSE SBL CAN REIMBURSE THE COST WHICH VERY LESS (APPROX-500 RUPEES )

kaizen_proposals.title: Testing management system
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: As of now we don't have any system to track and manage long term testing. Most of the time user miss test due date , observation date due to multiple number of testing. Additionally we don't have any system that can record and save the testing details of any panel or any chemistry. This will help us in observing the data in future.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: A online system that records the data of panel , testing, provide transperancy to the tester and save records for future use.

kaizen_proposals.title: implementation of charging hopper along with stool to get ease of operation and less spillage at floor
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: there is direct facility for powder bag charging into HSD which result in power spillage, chances of bag goes into HSD
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Charging hopper with stool provided and currently charging operation got smooth

kaizen_proposals.title: Cleaning system for mixers(Opaque/Primer, Metallic and Clear)by implementing AODD pump facility with piping system
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Before installation of new cleaning facility , we were doing the big size mixers manually with long brush, now cleaning system has been implemented with some mixers and rest mixers same implementation is going on
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Cleaning system for mixers(Opaque/Primer, Metallic and Clear)by implementing AODD pump facility with piping system

kaizen_proposals.title: Improving efficiency of STP Pump
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Currently STP pump gets pebbles and stones in line which damage the water meter, to prevent damage to water meter, the line was equipped with SS Jali, which gets choked easily due to dirt so flow of pump gets reduced.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Pump should be lifted 6 inches from floor level so that debris and dirt does not get into the pump and flow of water is increased.

kaizen_proposals.title: Clamp for pipe Jerk handle
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: डिस्पेंसिंग प्वाइंट प्वाइंट पर मटेरियल ट्राली में डालते समय , प्रेशर से पाइप का बाहर आ जाना, जिससे मटेरियल स्पिलेज का खतरा रहता है, और आदमी के चोट लगने की संभावना होना।
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: क्लैम्प की सहायता से इसको पकड़ के रख सकते है जिससे पाइप पे, प्रेशर के कारण झटका लगने पर रोका जा सकता है या कम किया जा सकता है।

kaizen_proposals.title: container reuse after rmqc testing
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: new containers after testing in rmqc throw out for scraping
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: to use these containers for batch making as same required in R&D and  foc samples

kaizen_proposals.title: Elimination of 20LTR Barrel cutting by using Borescope Camera for Internal Checking.
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement:
For checking inside cleanliness and Glue of 20 ltr barrels, barrels is cut using cutter/blade.
after cutting barrel becomes damage and scrapped.
This process causes material loss, Increases inspection cost, safety risk( sharp edges, blade injury).
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented:
Replace barrel cutting method with inspection camera for internal checking of 20 ltr barrels.
insert camera from barrel mouth and inspect dust, moisture, glue oil contamination, view inspection on screen in real time rotate barrel for 100% internal visual inspection.

kaizen_proposals.title: MAKE A DIGITAL LETTER REGISTER
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: CURRENTLY WE ARE NOTING DOWN THE DATA IN THE REGISTERS
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: WE PROPOSE TO CREATE A DIGITAL LETTER REGISTRY SYSTEM

kaizen_proposals.title: DRUM PAINTING
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: WE HAVE DAMAGE DRUMS ON SITE WHICH CAN BE UTILIZED CREATIVELY
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: COST SAVING

kaizen_proposals.title: CREATE A GOOGLE FORM IN WHICH WE PROVIDE LABOUR BENEFIT TO ALL THE EMPLOYEES
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: BEFORE THAT WE USE PAPER FORM BUT NOW WE USE GOOGLE FORM
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: PSYCHOSOCIAL IMPROVEMENT

kaizen_proposals.title: PORTABLE SPRINKLING SYSTEM
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: CURRENTLY WE ARE USING WATER HOS PIPE FOR WATERING IN THE GARDEN
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: PORTABLE SPRINKLER SYSTEM TO BE USED FOR AUTOMATING THE WATER PROCESS

kaizen_proposals.title: Automation of water filling of water tanks
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Currently manpower is engaged in filling of water tank manually
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Automation is proposed so that water is filled in automated mode when the tank is empty

kaizen_proposals.title: DRUM PAINTING

kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Elevated manhole cover to be removed as vehicles may get collision

kaizen_proposals.title: Kitchen Waste Storage Bin
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Currently kitchen waste is stored in 200 liters metallic drums, in which food starts to rot due to moisture and closed condition.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: A trolley with perforated jali to be fabricated for storing of kitechen waste

kaizen_proposals.title: Use of magnet to hold termperature meter
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Currently temperature meter is kept on working area which hinders work
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Temperature meter shall be hanged on hollow metal surface using magnet

kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Use of netallic wrist band to dissipate static earthing

kaizen_proposals.title: Bigger Earthing clamp
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Currently wrist band have small clamp which dont fit on trolley
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: bigger clamp to be fit so that earthing can be done properly

kaizen_proposals.title: FLP Weighing Balance
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: The weighing balance in Unit 1 were not FLP and to procure all new 36 FLP weighing balance a cost of Rs 40 lacs was qouted.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: It was proposed to change to indictor of the weighing balance only which was qouted Rs 6 lacs only. and make weighing balance

kaizen_proposals.title: Kaizen Proposal
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: CURRENTLY COVERS ARE IN TWO PARTS AND OUT LET PIPE FROM DYNO MILL ATTACHED TO TROLLEY RESULTING IN LID TO OPEN , RESULTING IN SOLVENT EVAPORATE
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: TROLLEY LID TO BE PROPER COVER WITH TOP HAVING HOLE FOR OUT LET PIPE ATTACHMENT

kaizen_proposals.title: Kaizen Proposal
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Currently, every laboratory does not have a dedicated first aid box. Minor injuries such as cuts from blades, glassware, or chemical splashes may not receive immediate treatment. There is also no defined person responsible for checking first aid supplies regularly, which may lead to expired or missing items. This can delay treatment, increase safety risks, and affect employee confidence.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented:
Install one standard first aid box in every laboratory and on each production floor
Assign one supervisor or responsible person for each area to inspect the first aid box weekly or monthly using a checklist
Maintain a First Aid Inspection Register to record
Date of inspection
Condition of the box
Expiry date of medicines
Items used and replenished
Name and signature of the responsible person
Replace expired or used items immediately to ensure the kit is always ready for emergency use and also for audit readiness

kaizen_proposals.title: Kaizen Proposal
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: All acids bottles are kept in tray with sand below bottles.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: We kept all acids bottles in tray with sand.

kaizen_proposals.title: Kaizen Proposal
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Tipco Electrical Cabinet was mounted at a height not safe for operation.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Asked to remount the Electrical Cabinet at a height where user's height can be reached easily.

kaizen_proposals.title: Kaizen Proposal
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Currently, various notifications, circulars, instructions and important information are pasted directly on the walls of the R&D department. This creates an unorganized appearance, increases wall clutter and makes it difficult to identify important and updated information
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Provide a dedicated notice board at a suitable and easily visible location in the R&D department. All official notifications, important instructions, safety information, announcements and other relevant communication should be displayed systematically on the notice board. Old or expired notices should be removed periodically to maintain the board in an updated and organized condition

kaizen_proposals.title: Kaizen Proposal
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: Time taken to pump 5KL batch raw material is too long
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Change Diaphragm Pump with other reactor pump which is more fast and less noisy.

kaizen_proposals.title: Kaizen Proposal
kaizen_proposals.problem_statement: There are lot of fumes during charging and unloading batches of Resin.
kaizen_proposals.solution_implemented: Install exhaust fan on the wall behind reactors at ground floor. Also change the place of exhaust fan at boiler area to improve suction of boiler fumes.
